scope: The 48 source-prefix-locked public-anchor pairs and 96 current-user variants produced by V5.4 authoring V2

measurement_boundary.fidelity_is: A construction-quality gate: public-world faithfulness, dialogue continuity, realization of the randomized descriptive assignment, and one-axis minimality.

fields.WORLD_FIDELITY_A_B: PASS only if the variant can be a faithful current continuation using the locked public prefix, original current turn as world/tone reference, and verified prior candidate without inventing a past result, diagnosis, identity, owner, relationship, or future fact.
fields.DIALOGUE_COHERENCE_A_B: PASS only if the variant is a natural continuation of the exact locked prefix, including public datasets with empty prefixes or consecutive same-role segmentation.
fields.ASSIGNMENT_FIDELITY_A_B: PASS only if the variant expresses its private descriptive construction instruction. This is instruction compliance, not a judgment of whether ON will help.
fields.SINGLE_AXIS_MINIMALITY: PASS only if A and B retain the same user, entity, topic, tone, goal frame, and approximate burden while differing only in the assigned current response-need, redundancy, or boundary factor.
fields.UNSUPPORTED_CRITICAL_FACT: PRESENT only for a newly asserted unsupported past event/result, diagnosis, owner/identity, relationship, acute-safety fact, or future fact; ordinary present emotion or request wording is not a critical invention.
fields.RESPONSE_OR_SCAFFOLD_LEAK: PRESENT if either variant writes the assistant's final response or exposes component, resource, construction, route, evaluator, or expected-outcome scaffolding.

pair_projection.PASS: all A/B world, coherence, and assignment fields PASS; SINGLE_AXIS_MINIMALITY PASS; unsupported critical fact ABSENT; response/scaffold leak ABSENT
pair_projection.FAIL: at least one resolved required field FAIL or one prohibited event PRESENT
pair_projection.UNRESOLVED: no resolved failure is present and at least one required field is UNRESOLVED

dual_reviewer_fidelity.single_reviewer_critical_flag: Requires an outcome-blind adjudication before the pair can pass; it is not erased by majority vote.
dual_reviewer_fidelity.disagreement_policy: Retain both raw judgments and mark pair unresolved; never manufacture gold by majority vote or by opening outcomes.
dual_reviewer_fidelity.failure_action: Stop before Rank-1 promotion, representation testing, response effects, or PM training; diagnose the construction instrument separately.

production_rank1_recomputation.order: May be implemented in parallel, but no pair is promoted until the fidelity gate passes or every fidelity issue is outcome-blind resolved.
production_rank1_recomputation.runtime_query: the exact source prefix plus the authored current user turn
production_rank1_recomputation.candidate_pool: the same-user strictly-prior public-source pool reconstructed by the frozen production adapter; no evaluator-only answer, summary, future event, or construction assignment
production_rank1_recomputation.retriever: the frozen V5.3 production candidate discovery and six-card RS runtime identified by release bindings
production_rank1_recomputation.execution_candidate: exact production Rank-1 after typed compiler and hard structural gates
production_rank1_recomputation.pair_isolation_requirement: A and B must both retain the same non-null exact Rank-1 resource id as the frozen source candidate; otherwise candidate identity changes with the treatment and the pair cannot identify a state-semantic effect for that resource.
production_rank1_recomputation.rank1_shift_or_absence: retrieval/data-construction failure with no PM label; never promote Rank-2, edit the query after seeing Rank-1, or call it semantic OFF
required_reports: candidate availability by component and variant
exact frozen-candidate Rank-1 retention by component
rank1 shift target ids and margins
owner, strict-past, version, and source-lineage integrity
production_rank1_recomputation.promotion_requirement: 12 accepted same-candidate families per component before effect feasibility. If fewer survive, replenish from new outcome-blind anchors and rerun this same frozen gate; do not relax it.
